A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human">During the Cold War, only [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] families held positions of prominence in the Sith Empire, and the members of Sith families almost always joined the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]; thus, the officer's family must have been Humans.</ref> '''family''' was prominent in the society of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire. [[Unidentified Imperial officer (colonel)|One member]] of the family used the family's influence to acquire a promotion to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] despite a lack of experience.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Pulling Rank}}</ref>
